mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tightening labor market that often precedes monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 102.0, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that often triggers monetary policy easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 102.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls, it signals a tightening monetary policy cycle coupled with a strong labor market, often preceding a recession and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise and industrial production (INDPRO) falls, it indicates economic divergence where housing strength contrasts with manufacturing weakness, often leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 320), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong GDP growth regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals continued economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
